release: Special educational needs in England, and the SEN2 education health and care plans return
bank: none, this dataset has no fetch or transform script
provenance: Hand-authored and committed in a7bbed2. The 25 rows were transcribed from the 2023/24 academic year, with five-year growth measured from 2019/20. DfE publishes this through the explore-education-statistics API, so of the three place-profile datasets this is the one with a real machine-readable source to build against first.
manualFields: every row: no generator exists, so nothing regenerates when DfE publishes
blockedOn: no fetch or transform script exists for this dataset, so there is nothing to run. Building one widens coverage past the 25 hand-picked areas, which changes the comparison set behind every pressure-index percentile the site publishes.
